f: In which year was the Prophet ﷺ born?
b: The Year of the Elephant, around 570 CE.

f: In which month and on which day of the week was the Prophet ﷺ born, according to the best-known view?
b: Rabi' al-Awwal, on a Monday.

f: Who was the father of the Prophet ﷺ, and when did he die?
b: 'Abdullah ibn 'Abd al-Muttalib; he died before the Prophet ﷺ was born.

f: Who was the mother of the Prophet ﷺ?
b: Aminah bint Wahb.

f: Who nursed the Prophet ﷺ in the desert?
b: Halimah al-Sa'diyyah of Banu Sa'd.

f: What happened to the Prophet ﷺ while he was with Banu Sa'd as a child?
b: Two angels opened his chest, removed a portion from his heart and washed it: the first opening of the chest.

f: How old was the Prophet ﷺ when his mother died, and where did she die?
b: About six; she died at al-Abwa' on the way back from Madinah.

f: Who took care of the Prophet ﷺ after his mother died?
b: His grandfather 'Abd al-Muttalib, then, after his death two years later, his uncle Abu Talib.

f: What did the monk Bahira see in the Prophet ﷺ?
b: The signs of prophethood, when the young Prophet ﷺ travelled with Abu Talib to Syria.

f: What title did the Quraysh give the Prophet ﷺ before prophethood?
b: Al-Amin: the trustworthy.

f: How did the Prophet ﷺ settle the dispute over the Black Stone when the Ka'bah was rebuilt?
b: He placed it on a cloth, had a leader of each clan lift a corner, then set it in place with his own hands.

f: Who was the first wife of the Prophet ﷺ?
b: Khadijah bint Khuwaylid رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا.

f: How old was the Prophet ﷺ when he married Khadijah رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا?
b: Twenty-five.

f: Where did the Prophet ﷺ go to worship before revelation?
b: The Cave of Hira'.

f: How old was the Prophet ﷺ when revelation began?
b: Forty.

f: What were the first verses revealed?
b: The opening verses of Surat al-'Alaq: "Read in the name of your Lord who created."

f: Who was Waraqah ibn Nawfal?
b: Khadijah's رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا cousin, a Christian scholar who confirmed that the angel was the same one who came to Musa عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.

f: Who was the first woman to accept Islam?
b: Khadijah رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا.

f: Who was the first free man to accept Islam?
b: Abu Bakr al-Siddiq رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ.

f: Who was the first child to accept Islam?
b: 'Ali ibn Abi Talib رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ.

f: How long was the call to Islam kept private at first?
b: About three years.

f: In whose house did the early Muslims gather in Makkah?
b: Dar al-Arqam, the house of al-Arqam ibn Abi'l-Arqam رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ.

f: Who was the first martyr in Islam?
b: Sumayyah bint Khayyat رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا, the mother of 'Ammar رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ.

f: How was Bilal رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ tortured, and what did he say?
b: He was laid on the burning sand with a rock on his chest, and kept saying "Ahad, Ahad": One, One.

f: To which land did the first Muslims emigrate?
b: Abyssinia (al-Habashah), ruled by the just king al-Najashi.

f: Who spoke for the Muslims before al-Najashi?
b: Ja'far ibn Abi Talib رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ, who recited from Surat Maryam.

f: For how long were Banu Hashim boycotted in the valley of Abu Talib?
b: About three years.

f: What is the Year of Sorrow ('Am al-Huzn)?
b: The year Khadijah رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا and Abu Talib died, about three years before the Hijrah.

f: What happened when the Prophet ﷺ went to Ta'if?
b: He was rejected and stoned until his feet bled; he refused to ask for them to be destroyed, hoping for believers among their descendants.

f: What is al-Isra' wa'l-Mi'raj?
b: The Night Journey from Makkah to al-Masjid al-Aqsa and the ascension through the heavens.

f: What was made obligatory during the Mi'raj?
b: The five daily prayers.

f: Why is Abu Bakr رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ called al-Siddiq?
b: Because he immediately affirmed the Night Journey when others doubted it.

f: What were the Pledges of 'Aqabah?
b: Two pledges given by people of Yathrib (Madinah) to the Prophet ﷺ, the second promising to protect him.

f: Who was sent to teach Islam in Madinah before the Hijrah?
b: Mus'ab ibn 'Umayr رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ.

f: Who slept in the Prophet's ﷺ bed on the night of the Hijrah?
b: 'Ali ibn Abi Talib رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ.

f: Who accompanied the Prophet ﷺ on the Hijrah?
b: Abu Bakr al-Siddiq رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ.

f: In which cave did they hide for three nights?
b: The Cave of Thawr.

f: Which verse describes the Prophet ﷺ and Abu Bakr رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ in the cave?
b: "…the second of two, when they were in the cave, when he said to his companion: Do not grieve, Allah is with us" (al-Tawbah 9:40).

f: Which mosque did the Prophet ﷺ build first on arriving near Madinah?
b: Masjid Quba'.

f: In whose house did the Prophet ﷺ stay when he first came to Madinah?
b: Abu Ayyub al-Ansari رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ.

f: What did the Prophet ﷺ do to unite the Muhajirun and the Ansar?
b: He joined them in brotherhood, pairing each emigrant with a helper.

f: When does the Hijri calendar begin, and who established it?
b: From the year of the Hijrah; it was adopted under 'Umar رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ.

f: In which year was the qiblah changed to the Ka'bah?
b: In the second year after the Hijrah.

f: When was the fast of Ramadan made obligatory?
b: In the second year after the Hijrah.

f: When and where was the first great battle?
b: Badr, 17 Ramadan, 2 AH.

f: How many Muslims fought at Badr, roughly?
b: About 313.

f: Which Qurayshi leader was killed at Badr?
b: Abu Jahl.

f: When was the Battle of Uhud?
b: Shawwal, 3 AH.

f: Why did the Muslims suffer losses at Uhud?
b: Most of the archers left their post on the hill against the Prophet's ﷺ order.

f: Which uncle of the Prophet ﷺ was martyred at Uhud?
b: Hamzah ibn 'Abd al-Muttalib رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ, the Master of Martyrs.

f: What was the Battle of the Trench (al-Khandaq)?
b: In 5 AH the allied tribes besieged Madinah; the Muslims dug a trench on Salman al-Farisi's رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ advice.

f: What was the Treaty of al-Hudaybiyah?
b: A ten-year truce with Quraysh in 6 AH, which Allah called a clear victory in Surat al-Fath.

f: What was the Pledge of Ridwan?
b: The pledge the Companions made under the tree at al-Hudaybiyah, when they heard 'Uthman رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ had been killed.

f: To whom did the Prophet ﷺ send letters inviting to Islam after al-Hudaybiyah?
b: Rulers including Heraclius of Rome, Khosrow of Persia, al-Muqawqis of Egypt and al-Najashi of Abyssinia.

f: When was Khaybar conquered?
b: 7 AH.

f: When was Makkah opened (Fath Makkah)?
b: Ramadan, 8 AH.

f: What did the Prophet ﷺ say to the Quraysh on the day of the opening of Makkah?
b: "Go, for you are free": he forgave them.

f: Which battle came straight after the opening of Makkah?
b: Hunayn, in Shawwal 8 AH.

f: What was the expedition of Tabuk?
b: The last expedition, in 9 AH, against the Romans in hard heat; no fighting took place.

f: What is the Year of Delegations ('Am al-Wufud)?
b: 9 AH, when tribes from across Arabia came to Madinah to accept Islam.

f: When did the Prophet ﷺ perform his only Hajj?
b: 10 AH: the Farewell Pilgrimage (Hajjat al-Wada').

f: Where did the Prophet ﷺ give the Farewell Sermon?
b: At 'Arafah during the Farewell Pilgrimage.

f: When did the Prophet ﷺ pass away?
b: Monday, Rabi' al-Awwal, 11 AH, at the age of sixty-three.

f: Where is the Prophet ﷺ buried?
b: In the room of 'A'ishah رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا, next to his mosque in Madinah.

f: Who led the prayer during the Prophet's ﷺ final illness?
b: Abu Bakr al-Siddiq رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ.

f: Who were the children of the Prophet ﷺ?
b: Al-Qasim, Zaynab, Ruqayyah, Umm Kulthum, Fatimah رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا and 'Abdullah from Khadijah رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا, and Ibrahim عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ from Mariyah رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ.

f: Which child of the Prophet ﷺ outlived him?
b: Fatimah رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا, for about six months.

f: Who are the Mothers of the Believers?
b: The wives of the Prophet ﷺ, رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُنَّ.

f: Which two of the Prophet's ﷺ daughters married 'Uthman رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ?
b: Ruqayyah, then after her death Umm Kulthum; so he is called Dhu'l-Nurayn.

f: Who are the ten promised Paradise?
b: Abu Bakr رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ, 'Umar رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ, 'Uthman رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ, 'Ali رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ, Talhah رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ, al-Zubayr رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ, 'Abd al-Rahman ibn 'Awf رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ, Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ, Sa'id ibn Zayd and Abu 'Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ.

f: Who were the four rightly guided caliphs, in order?
b: Abu Bakr رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ, 'Umar رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ, 'Uthman and 'Ali رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ.

f: Which book by Imam al-Tirmidhi رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ describes the Prophet's ﷺ appearance and character?
b: Al-Shama'il al-Muhammadiyyah.

f: Who wrote the best-known early Seerah that survives?
b: Ibn Hisham رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ, editing the work of Ibn Ishaq.

f: Which poem in praise of the Prophet ﷺ did Imam al-Busiri رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ write?
b: Al-Kawakib al-Durriyyah, known as Qasidat al-Burdah.
